signals.text: 3 open PM roles across 1 US office
3 new PM roles posted this week

bullets: 0-to-1 scope: The products you will work on are new territory for us. There are no established frameworks, no prior PM who has figured it out.
Product complexity: Property tax rules vary county by county. Specialty vehicle insurance involves regulatory and product complexity that doesn't exist in standard auto. These are…
Real impact: You will have meaningful ownership. And what you do will likely materially impact the trajectory of our business over the next few years.
Insatiable learner: You are constantly seeking to deepen your knowledge, sharpen your skills, and master whatever craft or goal you’ve set your mind to.
Owner: You act like your name is on the door. If something is broken, you feel responsible for fixing it, even if it’s outside of your swim lane.
Tenacious: You are highly resilient. No challenge is too difficult, no issue unsolvable.
Sense of urgency: You have a strong bias for action and are impatient when progress is stalled.
